outgoing.explanation: The 1627/1636 Ellingfield abuttals independently document the widow's former copyhold at manor-court level.

sources.excerpt: terr[am] nup[er] Margerie Gurney vid[ue] ... terr[am] quond[am] Margarete Gurney vid[ue] (at Ellingfield in East Dereham)
sources.locator: DGS 004389483: fo. 25, court of 3 Apr 1627 (ark 3:1:S3HY-D1S9-CYG); fo. 132, court of 10 Oct 1636 (ark 3:1:S3HY-D1S9-7DQ)

statement: The East Dereham manor courts of 3 April 1627 (folio 25) and 10 October 1636 (folio 132) each recite copyhold land at Ellingfield in East Dereham as formerly of Margery/Margaret Gurney, widow ("terram nuper Margerie Gurney vidue"; "terram quondam Margarete Gurney vidue") - boundary clauses read at full resolution, showing a Gurney copyhold tenancy in the parish that was already a past reference by 1627.
